policy: Append new evidence; never rewrite or delete an existing entry. Correct mistakes with a new superseding entry.

entries.subject: Windows x86_64 libmpv source-captured build
entries.summary: Source download and lock capture passed; the build stopped in spirv-cross-patch because Git could not auto-detect an email address.
limitations: No libmpv binary artifact was produced.
entries.next_action: Configure a deterministic ephemeral Git identity, test the workflow contract, then request separate approval for one new build.

entries.subject: Real application single-instance IPC routing smoke
evidence: User-confirmed interactive smoke: second launch, local file handoff, and YouTube URL handoff
entries.summary: All three user-observed routing scenarios completed successfully in the real application.

This is not installed-artifact evidence and does not validate a newly built DLL.
entries.next_action: Retain this as bounded IPC behavior evidence; do not transfer it to packaging or libmpv source-build claims.
